I’m Rishit Lahoti, an Artificial Intelligence & Data Science student at Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering. I build with Team Outliers, exploring how technology can solve practical problems across industries.

My learning spans Python development, generative AI, back-end development, data analysis, and agile practices. Competition builds are where those ideas meet real constraints.
